title: Weapon Leveling x Epic Fight Compat
description: Compatibility between Epic Fight Mod and Lukas' Weapon Leveling
body:
Level up during Epic Fights!


Features

Dual Wielding
Dual Wielding Weapons applies XP to the correct weapon used by the player. (Can work without in newer versions of epic fight)

Item Leveling
All Epic Fight Weapons and Armor Pieces are fully supported by this mod!


Why should I use this mod?

While Weapon Leveling can function with Epic Fight on its own, you may want to use it alongside it to level your offhand weapons (newer versions of epic fight can work without this compat layer). This was a feature in older versions of WL, so if you are using WeaponLeveling below 3.0.0, this mod is not needed.
The decision to split it into a new mod was made to make Future Updates faster and more streamlined.

Another Reason to use the mod is the added compatibility for all weapon types of Epic Fight. They are also easily customizable just by changing the levelable json files of each weapon type. The stray armor has support now too.




This is an official Addon for Weapon Leveling


Addon Info
This addon is made by GekidoLukas, the creator of Weapon Leveling. All Issues regarding this addon are to be posted on this mod's issue page. Requesting another compatibility addon can be done via Weapon Leveling's issue page
